correctness.rationale: Full matrix-unit computation yields the commutator rows (lambda_u-lambda_v)y_e+b_e(x_v-x_u). Cross-color rows are independently pivoted by individual off-diagonal variables; equal-color nonzero rows have graphic-incidence rank, with one dependence exactly when the unique cycle is fully supported. The labeling transfer matrix has eigenvalues 1+(q^2-1)z and 1-z. Correcting the exceptional full-cycle tuples yields the claimed rank polynomial. Connectedness gives center size q; coefficient extraction and evaluation at z=1/q yield cycle recovery and commuting-pair total. check_rank.py exhaustively tests six small instances from actual multiplication tables and exact finite-field row reductions.

value.rationale: Rank(ad_a) is the codimension of the centralizer of a, and its full distribution controls commuting probabilities in finite associative algebras. The result gives exact complete rank statistics for the infinite family of connected unicyclic height-two incidence algebras, uniformly in all finite fields. It shows that all pendant-tree arrangements collapse to just their edge count but the cycle length is recoverable already from rank-one multiplicity. This is a natural structural and enumerative distinction, not a one-off numeric slice.
